description: BICEP is a ground-based millimetre-wave bolometer array at the South Pole, built to measure the polarisation of the cosmic microwave background on degree scales.
facility_description: BICEP observes from the South Pole.
notes: NJM also lists 95GHz, 95GHz_rj, 150GHz_rj and 220GHz_rj. Takahashi et al. name 100, 150 and 220 GHz and do not define an _rj variant or a 95 GHz BICEP band, so those four keys have no Description. No requested acknowledgement was found. The only reuse terms opened for the article are the arXiv non-exclusive licence, which does not grant further reuse and says to contact the author. That is not a grant to redistribute a separate numeric curve. No magnitude system was recorded.

licence.terms: "which does not grant further reuse permissions directly. In these cases you will need to contact the author directly with your request."
